instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Forge operates as a venture studio, focusing on identifying and scaling high-growth B2B SaaS solutions within the complex supply chain and procurement landscape. The firm currently incubates four distinct companies spanning pre-seed through Series A funding rounds, managing technical development and market strategy internally.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company utilizes a quarterly venture pitch model where cross-functional teams evaluate innovation concepts against investment criteria before committing incubation funds. This process has successfully validated three distinct product hypotheses that have progressed into viable business units, demonstrating the studio's ability to execute.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior in global logistics; therefore, we must identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our core brand equity or operational capabilities in adjacent growing spaces rather than relying on incremental improvements.
answers.additionalContext: We are in the final stages of being acquired by a larger international group, which is expected to close in three months. This acquisition provides a strong impetus for modernization and suggests that our innovation efforts should be geared toward scalable, enterprise-ready solutions rather than purely niche experiments.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: Optimization of Incubation Funnel Metrics
opportunities.rationale: Focusing on incremental improvements in how ideas transition from pre-seed to Series A will maximize the efficiency of the existing formal process and reduce waste within the current budget constraints.

first_actions: Implement standardized KPIs for incubation project graduation
Conduct a full audit of current resource allocation vs. output metrics
resources_needed: 10 hours dedicated by one senior team member (existing budget)
Software license for advanced analytics tool subscription ($2,000)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in incubation cycle time by 15% within six months
milestones: Q1: Audit completion and KPI definition finalized.
Q2: Metric implementation and first report generated.

opportunities.title: Vertical Expansion via Open API Marketplace
opportunities.rationale: Forge should leverage its core supply chain data expertise to create an open platform offering specialized procurement APIs for non-competing industries (e.g., specialized medical logistics or sustainable materials sourcing). This radical move diversifies revenue streams entirely outside the current portfolio.

first_actions: Identify three high-value, adjacent industry API needs
Prototype a lean MVP API wrapper using existing technical talent
resources_needed: Contract labor for 2 months (leveraging acquisition prep budget)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure two pilot API integration contracts totaling $10,000 ARR
milestones: Q3: MVP development and initial documentation complete.
Q4: Launch of first public API gateway.

next_steps.action: Conduct a deep dive into potential adjacent market verticals (outside current supply chain focus)
Develop a high-level financial model for the radical diversification opportunity (API Marketplace) and seek preliminary internal seed funding/resource allocation proposals

key_weaknesses: Budgetary constraints severely limit the ability to sustain long-term, high-risk radical experiments.
Informal nature of the innovation function creates bottlenecks and inconsistent resource allocation across incubated companies.
High organizational culture risk concerning failure: The pressure from an imminent acquisition may stifle necessary experimentation and learning.
